description: Pinned immutable authorities for WASM-GEMM-GNAF. SPEC.md section 4.

wasmCore.note: Vendored from the official WebAssembly/spec repository at the pinned commit. SPEC 5 requires offline verification to recompute pins from CONTENT rather than trust a checksum string, so every vendored file's digest is recorded in SHA256SUMS and rechecked by the gate. Scope: document/core/{binary,valid,exec,syntax,appendix} -- the normative sources the conformance map cites -- plus licences.

lean.note: elan-installed toolchain reports exactly this commit.

leanPackages.note: Proof core uses only Lean core and Std. No network-fetched proof inputs.
